headline: ChatGPT will show ads while it generates images
dek: OpenAI starts testing the format in the US this October, leaning further on advertising to fund free access, according to Canaltech and Olhar Digital.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Ads arrive in image generation
body: OpenAI will test a new ad format inside ChatGPT, shown while the chatbot generates images. Testing starts this October in the United States with a limited group of advertisers (Canaltech, Olhar Digital).
Neither report said how many advertisers take part or how long the test will run before any wider release. OpenAI says the ads do not affect the image or the response (Canaltech).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: Beside the image, not inside it
s3.body: The sponsored piece appears separately in the interface during generation, next to the image being made rather than on top of it (Canaltech).

points.t: Ads are marked as sponsored content and can show products, usage ideas or experiences tied to what is being created (Canaltech).
Sensitive topics and moments of emotional vulnerability are excluded from ad placement, OpenAI says (Canaltech).
Advertisers get no conversations, only aggregated performance data about their own campaigns (Canaltech).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Ads fund the free tier
body: OpenAI sees advertising as a way to fund free and lower-cost access for its whole user base. Brands still cannot insert products inside the image a user requested (Canaltech).
Standard ads already sit below answers, with name, logo, link and image. Since August they run in Brazil for Free and Go users, while Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu see none (Canaltech).

items.t: The image-generation ad test begins in the United States with a limited group of advertisers (Canaltech).
DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science are helping OpenAI assess brand suitability and placement safety (Olhar Digital).
OpenAI gave no timeline for other markets or for a global advertising rollout (Canaltech, Olhar Digital).

caption.hook: OpenAI will test ads in ChatGPT image generation, shown beside the image while it is made, starting in the US this October.
body: The new placement builds on a fast rollout. According to Canaltech, OpenAI's first ad tests began in the US in February 2026, later reached Brazil, the UK, Mexico, Japan and South Korea, and expanded to 31 European countries in August. Olhar Digital reported ads also reached India that month.

In September OpenAI added sponsored agents, which open a conversation with a company-built system when a user follows an ad, plus AI tools to manage campaigns (Canaltech). Olhar Digital ties the push to rising competition, including Meta's free Muse app.
